CustomField.description: How many times a customer may swap a villa they have already signed for, within one SLA attempt. Releasing an unsigned hold is browsing and never counts. Grant an individual an extra one with ADHA_Applicant__c.Extra_Unit_Changes__c rather than raising this, which would hand everyone a third change retroactively. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Max Unit Changes
